System / Stripes Primer

Stripes Primer

Agent use: Read before using Stripes in prep. Some mechanics are unverified — check Stripes Bitemore for current confirmed details before encounter tuning.

Fast Read

  • Table role: Battle Master Fighter frontliner — confirmed subclass; full encounter math requires sheet verification.
  • Spotlight with: physical courage, direct threats, tribe/community stakes, and simple tactical space.
  • Pressure with: visible danger and hard choices rather than feature-specific counters.
  • Avoid: assuming Fighting Style, feats, exact ability scores, or damage output without sheet confirmation.

Data Gaps

FieldStatusImpact
SubclassBattle Master (confirmed — [[stripes-bitemoreStripes Bitemore]])
Fighting StyleUNKNOWNModerate — determines damage formula and tactical identity
Equipment / WeaponsUNKNOWNModerate — AC, damage, and weapon mastery all depend on loadout
Ability ScoresUNKNOWNModerate — all saves, attack bonus, HP, and AC are estimated from class baseline
Background / FeatsUNKNOWNLow-to-Moderate — feats like Sentinel or Shield Master would significantly change the analysis
LevelLevel 3 at last appearanceMay have advanced if reintroduced

Encounter Levers

  • Give them: clear front-line space and one obvious physical problem to solve.
  • If struggling: reduce tactical complexity until sheet details are confirmed.
  • If dominating: pressure with positioning and objectives, not unverified counters.
  • Avoid: designing around specific Battle Master maneuvers without sheet confirmation.

Roleplay Levers

  • Escalates: threats to tribe, duty, or the reason he was sent from home.
  • Calms: concrete evidence that action protects the community.
  • Dramatic lever: put personal glory against communal obligation.
  • Reintroduction hook: Sunken Crown / Keth-Naar — his tribe sent him west to find why the sea is angry.
